decisions.reason: Because the firm invested in developing this electronic music box and publicly committed to it on its website, and after only one year early disappointing results can still be attributed to temporary causes, escalation of commitment leads to keeping it.

As a traditional nativity stable close to the firm's core craft with visible public launch and only one season of results, the firm has little reason to drop it and escalation of commitment favors persistence.

The modern incense smoker aligns with the announced move toward contemporary designs, has public commitment and invested effort, and its early results can still be explained by temporary factors, so the firm tends to keep it.
